evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep never says the recognizable framing ('10 to 15 minutes, walk away with a quote you can depend on, does that sound good?') — jumps straight into pulling up the profile and probing.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep goes directly into logistics detail-gathering without asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Amy says: 'for a big loaded job I would be a bit conservative let's say, 35 to 45 minutes... Now for the estimate, your inventory seems pretty straightforward... I would suggest budget for about six to seven hours... six hour estimate is $1,875 plus seven hours, is $2,175 again anywhere from $1,875 to 2175.' She anchors with a typical range AND personalizes to the heavy items (gun safe, display cabinet) and prep suggestions.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Amy states: 'The hourly rate also includes the taxes, insurance, and the gas. The only thing bill outside of the hourly rate is a one time travel fee a month to $75... we have a two and a half hour minimum and to, to go beyond the two and a half hours, we will prorate the time in every fifteen minute increments.' Full fee transparency and commitment framing present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Amy moves directly from the estimate to 'Pricing hourly date plus one time, travel fee $75 and a two and a half hour minimum. I'll send you the copy via email' — no 'does that feel fair?' pause.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Not mentioned at all on this call.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Not mentioned at all on this call.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Amy says 'Let's, let me check what else. Okay. I think I got all the details that I need' and then moves to estimate, with no final concerns check later.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Amy asks: 'What do you think would you like us to help you out with the move?' Plainly asked, no built-in out.

top_strength: Amy gathered comprehensive logistics details through a natural phone-based walkthrough (bed, dresser, desk, gun safe, sectional, TV stand, dining table, display cabinet, desk, bench, bookshelf, chair, books, garage boxes) and confidently estimated a six- to seven-hour range ($1,875–$2,175) with clear anchoring and personalization to the heavy items.
coaching_note: Section 2 (Their Concerns) was completely skipped — Amy never asked 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' before diving into logistics, and Section 5 (Two Promises) was entirely missing, leaving the On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage undelivered; re-train on the full seven-section script flow to avoid these structural gaps.
